item.title: Agent Skills Deep Dive
item.description:
An agent skill is a reusable package of instructions, knowledge, resources, and tools that teaches an AI agent how to perform a specific kind of work. Instead of explaining your process again in every conversation, you can capture it once and give your agent a repeatable way to apply it when the situation calls for it.

And a good skill can be much more than a prompt.

It can contain your process and standards. It can reference supporting documents, templates, examples, and external resources. It can include scripts or code for steps that need to be deterministic rather than left to the judgment of an AI model. It can be tested, versioned, improved, and shared.

item.title: Prototype Driven Development: Keep Your Plan Flexible as You Build with AI
item.description:
Most of us were taught to plan everything up front, then build exactly what the plan says. When you’re building products with AI, that’s backwards.

In this live, online workshop, you’ll learn how two methods work together. Spec Driven Development (SDD) gives you the plan: you write down what you’re building and why, before an AI agent writes a line of code. Prototype Driven Development (PDD) keeps that plan honest: you hold it loosely, spin off fast, throwaway prototypes to answer the decisions you can’t make on paper, then fold what you learn back into the spec.
